description: A family trip journal that keeps every adventure alive — log destinations, memories, and moments before they fade.

landing.headline: Every family trip remembered forever
landing.subheadline: For families with kids who want to capture adventures, stories, and photos before the memories slip away — start logging your first trip in minutes.

features.title: Log every destination
features.description: Record where you went, when you went, and how long you stayed so no trip ever goes undocumented.

features.title: Capture the moments
features.description: Add notes, funny stories, and highlights from each trip so your kids can read them years later.

features.title: See trips on a map
features.description: View all your family destinations pinned on an interactive map to see how far you've explored together.

features.title: Rate the experience
features.description: Let every family member mark how much they loved a trip so you remember which places are worth returning to.

features.title: Browse by year
features.description: Filter your trip history by year to relive each summer, holiday, or long weekend at a glance.
